note: Each entry states why a causal role cannot currently be measured from primary sources. A documented insufficiency lets the readiness gate proceed past a role; it is never a claim that the role does not matter, and it is not a substitute for evidence.

insufficiencies.reason: Policy-rate, input-price and funding-disruption shocks are covered by control series, but the two spread series that carry funding-market disruption for pre-2023 episodes (ICE BofA high-yield and investment-grade option-adjusted spreads) are licensed and the public endpoint returns only a rolling three-year window. Technological obsolescence and asset-collateral shocks have no public index for the asset classes involved.

Bank exposure is covered by supervisory aggregates. Insurer, leveraged-fund, retirement look-through and network-concentration measures require N-PORT parsing, statutory filings and a relationship graph built to a uniform standard across episodes, none of which exists yet. Index and passive weights require an index-provider licence.
